result.topic_en: Derivation, from a variational principle, of the Poisson equation for the potential V of mass points, ΣdV/dη_i·dη = −4π dm, and of the equation of motion ∂V/∂η_i = ∂²η_i/∂t² for the mass points; this is followed by heavily struck-out attempts to describe the relative displacement of matter and aether points and the resulting volume change.

methods.what: Variation with respect to V yields a Poisson-type equation for the potential (source −4π dm)
Variational principle (action variation) under displacement of the mass points
methods.quote: $4\pi\int\sum_i \frac{\partial V}{\partial\eta_i}\delta\eta_i\, dm\, dt + 4\pi\int\sum \frac{\partial\eta_i}{\partial t}\,\delta\frac{\partial\eta_i}{\partial t}\, dm\, dt = 0$

methods.what: Integration by parts in time gives the equation of motion of the mass points (Newtonian law)
Total volume change as the integral of the Laplacian of V over the region occupied by the mass
methods.quote: $\int\left(\frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial\eta_1^2} + \frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial\eta_2^2} + \frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial\eta_3^2}\right) d\eta_1 d\eta_2 d\eta_3$

items.quote: also die Gesammte welche Integral über den ganzen $\int\left(\frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial\eta_1^2} + \frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial\eta_2^2} + \frac{\partial^2 V}{\partial\eta_3^2}\right) d\eta_1 d\eta_2 d\eta_3$ von Masse beträgt.
items.english: so the total [volume increase], which amounts to the integral of the Laplacian of V over the whole space filled by the mass.
